headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetry_accuracy_of_success
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hrLarge : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hcLarge : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
            (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
              ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ)
                (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (R : ℕ),
                ∀ s ≤ 1 - (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectedLaw r c U L).mass none,
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryLaw r c U L hrLarge hcLarge start h k fallback R)
                      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
                    (1 - s) ^ R + ↑R * (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_terminalCorrectedRetry_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ)
  (hrLarge :
    0 <
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
          (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2), List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hcLarge :
    0 <
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
          (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2), List.ofFn c)).length),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
                  (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))) →
          (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
            (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
              ∀
                (start :
                  Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c
                    (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7)
                (h k : ℕ) (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (R : ℕ),
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryLaw r c
                      (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7 hrLarge hcLarge
                      start h k fallback R)
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
                  (1 -
                        ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c
                              (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2))) /
                          ↑(2 *
                              (Fintype.card
                                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
                                      (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))) *
                                (Fintype.card
                                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
                                        (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance *
                                          (m + n - 2)))) -
                                  1)))) ^
                      R +
                    ↑R * (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k)
